items.title: Why GPs can’t prescribe Mounjaro; and new suicide warnings for starting SSRIs
items.summary: The new episode of Pulse in Focus: The Podcast for GPs is now live and available on all podcast platforms. Senior journalist Maya Dhillon talks to Pulse deputy news editor Anna Colivicchi about her new investigation into funding cuts for tirzepatide provision in general practice.

items.title: AI in Mental Health Airlock to support safe innovation
items.summary: A new regulatory sandbox will explore how safety approaches in innovative digital mental health technologies can be effectively evaluated and regulated.

items.title: BMS phase 3 Cobenfy readout teaser builds confidence for expansion
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has offered an early look at phase 3 data for Cobenfy in Alzheimer’s-related symptoms, which appears positive although details remain limited.

items.title: Nurses to help ‘shape’ plans for SW London mental health hubs
items.summary: A trust had said it is consulting the views of nurses to develop plans for new neighbourhood mental health centres in South West London.

items.title: iHV issues training guide for perinatal and infant mental health
items.summary: A new brochure to provide nurses, health visitors and other practitioners with specialist training information on perinatal and infant mental health has been launched by the Institute of Health Visiting (iHV).

items.title: Escalation and action guide helps to improve care for people with mental health needs in urgent and emergency care
items.summary: GIRFT has developed a shared operational framework to support with reducing delays and improving the quality and safety of care for people with mental health needs in urgent and emergency care (UEC) settings.

items.title: Escalation and action guide helps to improve care for people with mental health needs in urgent and emergency care
items.summary: GIRFT has developed a shared operational framework to support with reducing delays and improving the quality and safety of care for people with mental health needs in urgent and emergency care (UEC) settings.  The new guidance sets out national waiting time expectations, escalation triggers…

items.title: Evaluation Survey Launched on Digital Mental Health Technologies Programme
Prevent: guidance for NHS mental health services
Concerns raised over end of funding increase requirement for children’s mental health
items.summary: A decision to end specific ring-fenced funding increases for children and young people’s mental health services undermines the Government’s commitment to reduce waiting times in this group, a think tank has warned.

items.title: Deprivation worsens mental health in children with intellectual disabilities, study finds
items.summary: Children and young people with intellectual developmental disabilities (IDD) from disadvantaged backgrounds are more likely to experience mental health difficulties, according to new research led by University College London (UCL).
